907926cb97.notes_append: Carr's text gives the number: Moore arrives at "Kreizler's house, at 283 East Seventeenth Street," across from Stuyvesant Park. The number existed in the 19th century (an 1883 notice places the Sisters of St. John Baptist at No. 283 East Seventeenth Street), though the building is gone.

beea86de41.notes_append: The novel itself gives the number: "my grandmother's house at 19 Washington Square North."

e394c1ad2c.notes_append: The show sets the two houses across East 61st Street from each other; the two marks are pulled slightly apart so both can be clicked, not to claim which side each is on.
